researcher_notes: Source: 'Kivnon-Catalogo-2026-—-Editable-ENG.pdf' (23pp English full-line 'Edition 2026' product catalogue) + byte-identical duplicate '...-ENG-2.pdf' (md5 e5936bcb1bb6d83b199d3e448c921368, confirmed via md5 before processing; content captured once, both copies moved to Analysed/ together). Deferred across 3 prior sessions (52MB file size looked risky) but text extraction turned out clean and well-structured (per-model technical-sheet pages 7-14, clear TOC on p.2, portfolio map with a family/payload/nav/application summary table on p.6) -- fully processed this run, contrary to the earlier size-based deferral assumption. Covers 8 of Kivnon's 10 existing DB products (K05, K07, K10HP, K10P, K11, K32, K50, K55A, K60) via their family pages; K41 Platform has NO corresponding page in this catalog (not one of the catalog's '4 families / 8 models' -- Twister/Mouse/Tugger/Forklift lines only) and was not touched. Company-wide software/integration content (Kivnon Fleet Manager, VDA 5050, PLC/OPC-UA/TCP-UDP, ERP/MES/WMS/ASRS integration -- catalogue pages 17-18, section '13 - Software & Integration') was folded into each affected product's own fields rather than a separate company_wide_context block, since most Kivnon DB rows already have fleet_management_system/integration_capability filled from an earlier import batch and only 3 products (K07, K50, K60) had these fields genuinely null -- see those products' notes for the exact company-wide source citation. IMPORTANT DATA-QUALITY FINDING: this 2026 catalogue's per-family spec pages are DELIBERATELY COARSER than the DB's existing model-code granularity (e.g. one 'K10 One-Way Mouse' page covers what the DB splits into 'K10HP One-Way' and 'K10P One-Way' with different towing_capacity values, 5000kg vs 1800kg respectively) -- where the catalogue's single generic figure could not be confidently attributed to one specific existing DB sub-variant, NO field was filled/overwritten and the ambiguity is flagged in that product's notes rather than guessed. Multi-configuration families (K07 3 sub-models, K50 2 sub-models, K55 2 sub-models, K60 3 sub-models) were handled by matching the catalogue's per-sub-model numbers against each product's ALREADY-STORED non-null DB fields (e.g. max_payload, lifting_height) to identify which specific sub-model the existing DB row most likely represents, then using that sub-model's dimensions for enrichment -- documented per-product below; this is NOT full variant completion (no new product rows created this run despite genuine sub-model variation existing in the source), left as a flagged follow-up opportunity for a future session/Tech Lead decision given this run's time budget, consistent with the project's 'no guessing on ambiguous grouping' principle.
